record.d: The light, manoeuvrable bark-skinned canoe of the Indigenous peoples of the Eastern Woodlands, later used by voyageurs in the fur trade, built with bark over a cedar frame, sewn with spruce or pine root and sealed with resin.

items.why: A birchbark canoe is a boat people commission and own (builders sell to collectors); origin version of the existing Canoe kind, where 'Birch-bark' is already a material type.

Ambiguous resolved as product (a boat type people buy), but it already exists as the archetype 'Colin Archer type' (redningsskøyte, mk Colin Archer, versions RS 1 Colin Archer, Asgard) under Classic wooden yacht; the rubric's exists=false was a miss.
